name: Rifinbell
source:
The princess of Wolfin.
Clad in a gothic lolita dress, she's always seen with her favorite doll.
Though she speaks of herself in 3rd person, she is not very childish and actually quite clever.
She mocks others when talking with them, although only subtle, using their general unwillingness to deal with her to her favor.

[spoiler] Though she mentions wanting to play with dolls, she actually likes to play with humans as dolls by controlling them as she likes it.
She generally dislikes humans because half of them are male and thus not cute, though she makes exceptions in the case of Enoru [whom she even blackmails into sex] and her personal knight.

This resulted in her having lots of female personal knights in the past, though her ways of controlling them (domination, bondage, sexual advances) broke them all. 
This made her settle for her current personal knight, who doesn't mind licking her feet and the countless insults coming from her.
[/spoiler]
